'''Jean-Christophe Yoccoz''' (29 May 1957 – 3 September 2016) was a French [[mathematician]]. He was awarded a [[Fields Medal]] in 1994, for his work on [[dynamical system]]s.<ref>{{MacTutor Biography|id=Yoccoz}}</ref><ref name="death">{{cite web|url=http://www.huffingtonpost.fr/2016/09/05/deces-jean-christophe-yoccoz-mathematicien-medaille-fields_n_11865556.html|title=Le mathématicien Jean-Christophe Yoccoz est mort|date=5 September 2016 |access-date=6 September 2016}}</ref>

==Biography==
Yoccoz attended the [[Lycée Louis-le-Grand]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://louislegrand.org/index.php/hier-et-aujourdhui-articlesmenu-29/histoire/des-mathticiens-articlesmenu-35|title=Des mathématiciens|last=Administrator|access-date=6 September 2016}}</ref> during which time he was a silver medalist at the 1973 [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] and a gold medalist in 1974.<ref>{{IMO results|id=10261}}</ref><ref name="heidelberg">{{cite web|url=http://www.heidelberg-laureate-forum.org/blog/laureate/jean-christophe-yoccoz/|title=Jean-Christophe Yoccoz † › Heidelberg Laureate Forum|access-date=6 September 2016|archive-date=11 September 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160911075550/http://www.heidelberg-laureate-forum.org/blog/laureate/jean-christophe-yoccoz/|url-status=dead}}</ref> He entered the [[École Normale Supérieure]] in 1975, and completed an [[agrégation]] in mathematics in 1977.<ref name="A">{{cite web|url=http://www-history.mcs.st-and.ac.uk/Biographies/Yoccoz.html|title=Yoccoz biography|access-date=6 September 2016}}</ref> 

Yaccoz next completed a civil alternative to French military service, which he served at [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada]], [[Brazil]].<ref>{{cite web |title=IMPA participates in tribute to Jean-Christophe Yoccoz |url=https://impa.br/notices/impa-participates-in-tribute-to-jean-christophe-yoccoz/?lang=en}}</ref>  He then completed his [[PhD]] under [[Michael Herman (mathematician)|Michael Herman]] in 1985 at [[Centre de mathématiques Laurent-Schwartz]], which is a research unit jointly operated by the [[French National Center for Scientific Research]] (CNRS) and [[École Polytechnique]].<ref name="A" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.abc.org.br/article.php3?id_article=8037|title=Ciência se despede de matemático francês Jean-Christophe Yoccoz|access-date=6 September 2016|archive-date=19 September 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160919083015/http://www.abc.org.br/article.php3?id_article=8037|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=34221}}</ref> 

He took up a position at the [[University of Paris-Sud]] in 1987, and became a professor at the [[Collège de France]] in 1997, where he remained until his death.<ref name="death" /> He was a member of [[Nicolas Bourbaki|Bourbaki]].<ref>{{citation|title=Bourbaki: a secret society of mathematicians|first=Maurice|last=Mashaal|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|year=2006|page=19|isbn=978-0-8218-3967-6|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=-CXn6y_1nJ8C&pg=PA19}}</ref>

Yoccoz won the [[Salem Prize]] in 1988. He was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1990 at Kyoto,<ref name="B" /> and was awarded the [[Fields Medal]] at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1994 in [[Zürich]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mathunion.org/o/General/Prizes/Fields/1994/|title=Fields Medals and Nevanlinna Prize 1994|access-date=6 September 2016|archive-date=29 July 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160729172437/http://www.mathunion.org/o/General/Prizes/Fields/1994/|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="B">{{cite web|url=http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|title=International Mathematical Union (IMU)|access-date=6 September 2016|archive-date=8 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171108012153/http://www.mathunion.org/db/ICM/Speakers/SortedByCongress.php|url-status=dead}}</ref> He joined the [[French Academy of Sciences]] and [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]] in 1994, became a chevalier in the [[French Legion of Honor]] in 1995, and was awarded the Grand Cross of the Brazilian [[National Order of Scientific Merit]] in 1998.<ref name="heidelberg"/>

==Mathematical work==
Yoccoz's worked on the theory of [[dynamical system]]s. His contributions include advances to [[KAM theory]], and the introduction of the method of Yoccoz puzzles, a combinatorial technique which proved useful to the study of [[Julia set]]s.<ref name="heidelberg" />

==Notable publications==
* Yoccoz, J.-C. Conjugaison différentiable des difféomorphismes du cercle dont le nombre de rotation vérifie une condition diophantienne. Ann. Sci. École Norm. Sup. (4) 17 (1984), no. 3, 333–359. [[doi:10.24033/asens.1475]]
* Yoccoz, Jean-Christophe. [http://www.numdam.org/item/AST_1995__231__1_0/ Théorème de Siegel, nombres de Bruno et polynômes quadratiques. Petits diviseurs en dimension 1.] Astérisque No. 231 (1995), 3–88. {{mr|1367353}}
